title: One-point illusion

techniques.name: Projected construction

a9_grid_m.label: Grid pitch
a9_grid_m.note: Spacing of the blue grid painted on the room.

a9_density.label: Stipple density
a9_density.note: How many dots shade the shadow sides, as a multiple of the engine’s own.

a9_dot.label: Dot size
a9_dot.note: Size of every stipple dot, as a multiple of the engine’s own.

a9_contour.label: Contour weight
a9_contour.note: Weight of every silhouette and crease line, as a multiple of the engine’s own.

a9_field.label: Room tint
a9_field.note: The room’s walls and floor, from white (0) to the app’s mint (1).

a9_light_az.label: Light azimuth
a9_light_az.note: Where the light comes from around the room, which turns every shadow and stipple side.

techniques.implementation: Planes and stairs are drawn in one-point or isometric projection with hard flat color. Drawn by the source page’s own code on a clock this plate drives; its strokes, marks, inks and type pass through the dials.

techniques.name: Measured inks
techniques.implementation: solid ink pixels of each figure, read at full resolution, are clustered to five colors; a color is kept when it holds at least 4% of the ink.

techniques.name: Figure and ground
techniques.implementation: The ground is the most common border color of a figure; ink is every pixel more than 40 levels from it.

pass_order: read · points measured from the figure
